description: Per-passageway length, cross-sectional area and solvent-accessible volume at water and glucan scales
code:
exec(open("_lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from scipy import ndimage

SP=0.4
B=framed("3A8E"); P8=B[B.resn!="BGC"]
xyz=P8[["px","py","pz"]].values; rad=P8.el.map(VDW).fillna(1.7).values; tr=cKDTree(xyz)
xs=np.arange(-24,24.001,SP); zs=np.arange(-40,40.001,SP)
XX,YY=np.meshgrid(xs,xs,indexing="ij"); flat=np.column_stack([XX.ravel(),YY.ravel()])
Cg=np.empty((len(xs),len(xs),len(zs)),dtype=np.float32)
for k,z in enumerate(zs):
    d,i=tr.query(np.column_stack([flat,np.full(len(flat),z)]),k=16,workers=-1)
    Cg[:,:,k]=(d-rad[i]).min(1).reshape(len(xs),len(xs))
RR=np.broadcast_to(np.hypot(*np.meshgrid(xs,xs,indexing="ij"))[:,:,None]<20.,Cg.shape)
ZZ=np.broadcast_to(zs[None,None,:],Cg.shape)

sug=B[B.resn=="BGC"]
def vox(p): return (int(round((p[0]-xs[0])/SP)),int(round((p[1]-xs[0])/SP)),int(round((p[2]-zs[0])/SP)))

rows=[]
for probe,lab in [(1.4,"water probe 1.4 A"),(3.2,"glucan-scale probe 3.2 A")]:
    m=(Cg>=probe)&RR; lab_arr,n=ndimage.label(m)
    for site in ["E_0","F_0","G_0","F_1"]:
        cen=sug[sug.uchain==site][["px","py","pz"]].values.mean(0); ii=vox(cen)
        w=Cg[ii[0]-8:ii[0]+9,ii[1]-8:ii[1]+9,ii[2]-8:ii[2]+9]
        o=np.unravel_index(np.argmax(w),w.shape); seed=(ii[0]-8+o[0],ii[1]-8+o[1],ii[2]-8+o[2])
        l=lab_arr[seed]
        if l==0:
            rows.append(dict(probe=lab,site=site,volume_A3=0,length_z_A=0,Rmin=np.nan,Rmax=np.nan,
                             opens_top=False,opens_bottom=False)); continue
        comp=(lab_arr==l)
        vol=comp.sum()*SP**3
        zc=ZZ[comp]; Cc=Cg[comp]
        rows.append(dict(probe=lab, site=site, volume_A3=round(float(vol),0),
                         length_z_A=round(float(zc.max()-zc.min()),1),
                         Rmin=round(float(probe),2), Rmax=round(float(Cc.max()),2),
                         opens_top=bool(zc.max()>=34), opens_bottom=bool(zc.min()<=-34)))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows); T.to_csv("passageway_dimensions.csv",index=False)
print("=== per-passageway measurements, 3A8E octamer, cellopentaose deleted ===")
print(T.to_string(index=False))

# narrowest and widest cross-sectional area of each separate compartment at probe 3.2
m=(Cg>=3.2)&RR; lab_arr,n=ndimage.label(m)
print("\n=== cross-sectional area per z-slice for the four separate compartments (probe 3.2 A) ===")
out=[]
for site in ["E_0","F_0","G_0","F_1"]:
    cen=sug[sug.uchain==site][["px","py","pz"]].values.mean(0); ii=vox(cen)
    w=Cg[ii[0]-8:ii[0]+9,ii[1]-8:ii[1]+9,ii[2]-8:ii[2]+9]
    o=np.unravel_index(np.argmax(w),w.shape); seed=(ii[0]-8+o[0],ii[1]-8+o[1],ii[2]-8+o[2])
    l=lab_arr[seed]; comp=(lab_arr==l)
    areas=comp.sum((0,1))*SP**2
    nz=areas[areas>0]
    zr=zs[areas>0]
    out.append(dict(site=site, n_slices=len(nz), z_from=round(float(zr.min()),1), z_to=round(float(zr.max()),1),
                    area_min=round(float(nz.min()),1), area_max=round(float(nz.max()),1),
                    volume=round(float(comp.sum()*SP**3),0)))
X=pd.DataFrame(out); print(X.to_string(index=False)); X.to_csv("passageway_crosssections_probe32.csv",index=False)
print("\nreference: one extended beta-1,4-glucan chain has a vdW cross-section of ~12.4 x 8.2 A (~80 A^2);")
print("a 2-chain sheet needs >20 A in one direction (~160 A^2); a 4-chain (2x2) crystallite ~127 A^2 of")
print("crystallographic cross-section, ~20 x 16 A including vdW envelope.")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4.2))
for site,c in zip(["E_0","F_0","G_0","F_1"],["#dd6b20","#2b6cb0","#38a169","#805ad5"]):
    cen=sug[sug.uchain==site][["px","py","pz"]].values.mean(0); ii=vox(cen)
    w=Cg[ii[0]-8:ii[0]+9,ii[1]-8:ii[1]+9,ii[2]-8:ii[2]+9]
    o=np.unravel_index(np.argmax(w),w.shape); seed=(ii[0]-8+o[0],ii[1]-8+o[1],ii[2]-8+o[2])
    comp=(lab_arr==lab_arr[seed]); areas=comp.sum((0,1))*SP**2
    ax.plot(zs[areas>0],areas[areas>0],"-",color=c,label=f"passageway at site {site}")
ax.axhline(80,color="k",ls=":",lw=1); ax.text(-30,84,"cross-section of one glucan chain (80 A2)",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("height along the cylinder axis z (A)"); ax.set_ylabel("compartment cross-sectional area (A2)")
ax.set_title("The four passageways at a glucan-scale probe (3.2 A):\nclosed compartments confined to the cylinder waist")
ax.set_xlim(-40,40); ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=.3); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
